title: Stacking Adapters
definition: The practice of combining multiple LoRA adapters to enhance a base model's performance on specific tasks.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A technique used to improve a machine learning model's performance on specific tasks by combining multiple specialized adapters.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A machine learning approach that involves combining multiple LoRA adapters to address the challenge of catastrophic forgetting and improve a model's performance on various tasks.
difficulty_levels.expert: A philosophical examination of the potential and pitfalls of stacking multiple LoRA adapters to enhance a base model's performance, considering the challenges of catastrophic forgetting and base model reasoning.

extra_fields.insight: Stacking adapters is a promising technique for improving machine learning models, but it requires careful consideration of the trade-offs between flexibility and performance.
